authority: Canonical Velocity workflow topology with separate Search Intelligence observation/retest lane and exact-SHA CI health alert/recovery loop. Scheduled Search Intelligence does not commit source changes or alter publishing cadence.

global_contract.scheduled_mutation_policy: Scheduled workflows may commit to main, but only those named in allowed_scheduled_mutation_workflows, and only after the full validation chain passes in the same run. This was 0 while every change arrived through an external agent-run manifest. Content-factory lanes are now permitted to write on a timer; the allowlist keeps that an explicit decision per workflow rather than a general licence for anything scheduled to push.
global_contract.scheduled_mutation_rationale: Search Console evidence has to be refreshed on a cadence or the query atlas publishes against stale, modelled demand. This workflow commits only when the full validation chain passes in the same run. The cap of 1 is the control: any second scheduled mutator needs an explicit decision, not another file. 2026-10-11, owner decision: search-outcomes-weekly.yml is the second scheduled committer (cap raised 1 -> 2). It commits only reports/search_outcomes/<ISO-week>.{md,json}, once a week, after npm run validate:release passes in the same run, inside the shared local-guides-main-writer group.

workflows.name: CI Health Red Recovery
workflows.failure_boundary: A RED exact-SHA result is recorded and surfaced; no success state is inferred from a failed or unobserved run.

workflows.name: Daily Citation Intelligence
workflows.failure_boundary: Signal intelligence may update generated state but must not commit governance or source authority files.

workflows.name: Deploy Distribution
workflows.failure_boundary: The exact artifact commit SHA must match the validation attestation before distribution.

workflows.name: GSC Portfolio Report
consumes: Search Console API (service account gsc-bot, every property it can read)
live robots.txt and sitemap.xml of each property
produces: artifact gsc-<mode>-<run_id>: one JSON per property plus summary.json (also printed in the job log)
workflows.failure_boundary: Dispatch-only and read-only on the repo in every mode: it uploads an artifact and commits nothing. report reads 28-day search analytics; sitemaps writes only to Search Console (submits live sitemaps that are unlisted or errored, then re-lists); coverage runs URL Inspection under a 2,000/day portfolio budget. It exits non-zero when the account reads zero properties, when sitemaps finds no live sitemap anywhere, or when every inspection fails.

workflows.name: Query Class Occupancy Probe
consumes: OpenRouter via scripts/lib/free_llm_router.mjs ($0 models only; the billed web plugin is refused)
workflows.failure_boundary: Dispatch-only and gated: owner policy 11 Oct 2026 ("nothing should be paid ... cut the probes and make them free") took both probes off every schedule. confirm_paid (boolean, default false) must be true or the refuse job prints a NAMED STOP and nothing runs. Every model call goes through scripts/lib/free_llm_router.mjs: $0 models only, max_cost_usd 0, web plugin refused, so the occupancy probe stops by name (it needs the billed web plugin) and writes nothing - the committed readings stay, stale, never zero - and the citation probe runs in knowledge mode on $0 models. A reported non-zero cost fails the run.

workflows.name: Query Evidence Refresh
consumes: Google Search Console search-analytics query rows for the verified property
produces: Velocity Content Release run when measured demand produced candidates
workflows.failure_boundary: Ingests measured Search Console demand, rebuilds the atlas on the last committed citation-occupancy readings (the probes are off this schedule by owner policy, 11 Oct 2026; the cycle prints an LLM ROUTER RECEIPT from one $0 call through scripts/lib/free_llm_router.mjs), joins it to the release queue as page candidates, and commits only if the full validation chain passes in the same run. Named in allowed_scheduled_mutation_workflows. It has no page-admission authority: the join proposes candidates and the release law downstream still decides. A push made with GITHUB_TOKEN raises no push event, so when the join produces candidates this workflow dispatches Velocity Content Release explicitly; when it produces none it dispatches nothing and prints the named stop reason. Missing credentials leave the evidence untouched and exit 0; a credentialed API failure is a hard error. Occupancy readings stay as last committed - stale, never a false zero.

workflows.name: Search Intelligence Closed Loop
workflows.failure_boundary: Scheduled lane observes, diagnoses, queues, retests, and reports only. It has no independent page-admission, cadence, or repo-commit authority.

workflows.name: Validate Repo
workflows.failure_boundary: No artifact is uploaded as validated unless the staged container release passes.

workflows.name: Velocity Content Release
consumes: data/queries/measured_demand_candidates.json (measured query demand ranked by citation occupancy)
produces: Validate Repo run on the pushed main HEAD
workflows.failure_boundary: Absorption pushes on its own commit once the release gate passes on the normalized artifacts alone, so a content-release failure cannot un-absorb a landed agent run. The content release then pushes only after Safe Harbor/transactional release finalization, deterministic rebuild, release validation, exact-agent validation, and citation-fix validation pass. A push made with GITHUB_TOKEN raises no push event, so after any commit this workflow lands it dispatches Validate Repo on main: the absorption and release commits are validated by the same unmodified guards that govern them, and a repair that did not hold shows up red instead of leaving main pinned to a stale result.

workflows.name: Velocity Full Rebuild
workflows.failure_boundary: Push only after deterministic frozen-aware rebuild and release validation pass; broad self-healing is not permitted in the rebuild workflow.

workflows.name: Search Outcomes Weekly
consumes: Search Console API (service account gsc-bot, every property it can read)
committed index_coverage / strengthened_pages / consolidation_candidates files of the portfolio repos (GitHub raw, now and 7 days ago)
live HTTP status of each property's top 25 pages by 28-day impressions
the report's own 28-day query+page pull (discovery seeds: >= 2 impressions, top 40 per property)
free, keyless expansion: Google autocomplete, one Google SERP probe for People also ask, Reddit search.json
target_query_set / demand_families / measured_targets files of the portfolio repos (GitHub raw) for dedupe
produces: reports/search_outcomes/<ISO-week>.md and .json (committed), with the Discovery section
one GitHub issue per RED site in this repo, closed when the site is GREEN
email to the owner via Resend
workflows.failure_boundary: Exits non-zero when the account reads zero properties or an issue cannot be created. Coverage files that do not exist are reported as 'no coverage file', never a failure. Without RESEND_API_KEY the email step is a NAMED STOP and exits 0; a Resend refusal fails the run. Commits only the report pair, only after validate:release passes on the rebased tree. Discovery makes zero model calls and requests only free hosts (enforced in free_discovery.py and by the search-outcomes-weekly-report validator); a blocked source is recorded as unavailable, and zero candidates from every source is a NAMED STOP carried in the report.
